text:
Renee: Quick drop 1: one-page kit for goal-setting, self-review bullets, and a tiny hiring/headcount flag rule. Make it pasteable into 1:1s or JD notes.

Omar: exactly what I need. include how to flag paid training or new headcount requests.

Renee: short rules first: 1) One objective only. 2) 1-2 measurable KRs. 3) Tag any resource ask with [budget-request] or [headcount-request] and 1-line reason. HR will follow up.

Priya: can we get one-liners for managers to push back on vague goals?

Renee: paste these: • "What metric or visible outcome will tell us this worked?" • "This looks like tasks 10 convert into one measurable result." • "Which KR would you keep if we needed to cut scope?"

Julian: self-review cheat? engineers hate writing long stuff.

Renee: one-line self-review formula: "Outcome | Your role | Evidence (metric/link/PR)" e.g., "Reduced p95 by 120ms | Owned cache rollout | prod dashboard + PR#789"

Omar: hiring snippet to include in JDs so interviewers know expectations?

Renee: 90-day deliverable line (paste into JD/interview guide): "90-day key deliverable: Make measurable progress on [team OKR one-liner]. Signals: shipped PRs, stakeholder alignment notes, dashboard link."

HR-bot: Reminder: if you use [budget-request] or [headcount-request], HR will reach out within 3 business days for intake.

Priya: calibration scoring quick card? managers need parity across teams.

Renee: Use: "Impact: H/M/L | Certainty: 0-100% | Effort: low/med/high | Dependency: <tag> | Budget: [none or budget-request]" Example: "High | 75% | med | payments-dep | none"

Julian: mid-cycle change phrasing? helps avoid awkwardness renaming KRs.

Renee: two-liner: "Context: [short reason]. Proposed change: [new KR one-liner]. Rationale: this preserves customer impact / reduces risk. Approve?"

Omar: tiny manager script for performance conversations? compassionate but clear.

Renee: script: "We need to see steady improvement on X over the next 60 days. I'll meet weekly to unblock you and we'll set measurable checkpoints. HR is available for support if helpful."

Priya: can we include a short peer-feedback prompt set for calibration?

Renee: 3-line peer prompts: 1) One concrete result I noticed. 2) One way they helped unblock work. 3) One area to grow next quarter (short). Keep answers <3 lines.

HR-bot: Note: PIP language should be reviewed with HR before sending; see HR PIP guidance doc.

Omar: saving this into manager playbook. Thanks Renee.

Renee: happy to iterate 1 ping me if you want a variant that auto-inserts OKR IDs or includes sample scoring examples.
